name: Agent Connect
summary: Your messaging channels, added when you need them.
description: Connect the 33 integrations provided by the existing Agent Connect package. Telegram and Discord use its Node transports; other channels retain their optional isolated Python setup. Adding the app does not sign in to a new account or install Python providers. Previously enabled channels can resume after restart. Your channel settings and history stay when you remove it.
permissions: Connects the channels you explicitly enable
Keeps existing channel settings and delivery history
Provides restricted channel send tools for your agents
